projects.intervention_detail: Multicentre, single-arm, open-label phase 2 trial: oral live biotherapeutic Lactococcus lactis GEN-001 (L. lac_G01), once daily, combined with the anti-PD-L1 antibody avelumab, in 42 PD-L1-positive advanced gastric cancer patients (43 fecal samples).
projects.title: Live biotherapeutic Lactococcus lactis strain combined with avelumab in gastric cancer: A multicenter, single-arm, open-label phase 2 clinical trial.
